sentences.text: A large green animal lived alone in a high place.
He was very kind and he loved a simple life.
He did not want to fight anyone at all.
Instead, he loved writing songs and reading long books each day.
He sat near the blue water and watched the green trees.
He played fine music and thought about beautiful art.
His days were full of rest and happy thoughts.
One morning, an old man from the local town walked up.
He was taking a long walk through the high land.
Suddenly, the old man saw the large animal near a rock.
The old man stopped because he was full of fear.
However, the animal gave a nice smile to the man.
The animal asked the old man to sit down.
They began to talk about books and life.
The animal showed his writing to the old man.
The old man was surprised because he was so kind.
They became very good friends before the day was over.
Soon, the other people in the town heard the news.
They thought that large animals were bad and full of risk.
The people felt great fear and wanted to protect their homes.
They went to a strong young man in the town.
This young man was a great fighter for the people.
They asked him to drive the big animal away.
The old man tried to explain the truth to everyone.
He said that the animal was kind and loved everyone.
However, the people did not listen to the old man.
They wanted the fighter to go up and fight.
The strong fighter walked up the high road the next day.
He was ready to face the large animal.
When he arrived, the animal was reading a new book.
The animal welcomed the fighter with a happy smile.
He asked the fighter to sit and share some food.
Instead of fighting, the two began to talk together.
They discussed art, history, and beautiful songs for many hours.
The fighter realized they had a lot in common.
He understood that the animal only wanted to live well.
The two friends needed a plan to help the town.
"The people are going to worry without an answer," he said.
"We are going to perform a play fight," the animal said.
"Then everyone will feel good and drop their fear," he added.
They chose a large open field near the village.
They were going to meet there on the next afternoon.
On the next day, all the town people came out.
They stood around the green field to watch the big event.
The fighter and the animal ran across the open ground.
They made deep sounds and hit their strong arms together.
They moved fast and played their parts with great energy.
It was a great show for the whole community.
Finally, the fighter appeared to win the game.
The people were happy and they called out his name.
The fighter told the people that the animal was a friend.
He asked the animal to come down into the town.
Everyone welcomed the large animal to a big evening party.
They ate good food, drank water, and danced together.
The animal read his writing and sang his favorite songs.
Everyone laughed and enjoyed the happy time with him.
From that day on, the animal lived well with new friends.
He was never alone again because he had a great family.

sentences.text: High up in the wild mountains, a nice animal lived alone.
Unlike other persons, he did not want to fight anyone.
Instead, he loved writing books and reading long stories.
He spent his days enjoying quiet music and watching green fields below.
He has always lived there happily for many years.
He often spent hours working on paper and creating new tales.
Every single morning brought fresh joy and peace to his heart.
His home was full of old paper and beautiful art.
No other person lived near him on that high peak.
He felt quite peaceful while the wind blew softly outside.
The sun shone brightly over the green trees every single day.
He loved his simple life in the deep mountains very much.
Nothing could disturb his quiet and calm daily routine.
One fine morning, an old man from the local town came up the mountain.
The man found the large animal resting near a big rock.
They started to talk, and the human was surprised by the animal.
The animal showed his newest books, and they became good friends.
They have shared many stories together since that first meeting.
The man smiled and told the animal how much he enjoyed the stories.
They talked about art, literature, and life for a long time.
The sun began to move down while they shared tea and food.
The old man promised to return again during the next week.
The animal felt very happy to make such a wonderful friend.
He had not spoken to anyone else for a very long time.
That meeting changed his quiet life in a very positive way.
He waited eagerly for the next visit from his new friend.
Soon, the people heard about the animal living on the hill.
They felt very afraid because they believed all such animals were dangerous.
The local people asked a strong soldier to come and drive the animal away.
However, the old man knew that the individual meant no bad things.
If the soldier went up, he would see the truth.
The townspeople gathered in the square to discuss the big problem.
They worried that the beast might attack their homes at night.
The mayor told the soldier to protect the town from danger.
The soldier took his heavy sword and began to climb the steep path.
Many people watched him leave with deep concern and fear.
They hoped that the soldier would keep everyone safe from harm.
The climb was long and difficult under the hot sun.
Finally, the soldier reached the top of the mountain.
The soldier walked up the mountain to face the animal.
Instead of fighting, they talked about art, literature, and life.
They realized that they had much in common.
The soldier understood that the animal simply wanted to live in peace.
They have talked for hours about their favorite books.
The soldier looked at the written pages with great interest.
He discovered that the animal was kind and very smart in many ways.
They shared stories about their past experiences and future hopes.
The soldier laughed when the animal told a funny joke.
Both of them forgot about the war and the struggle below.
They agreed that fighting was a terrible waste of human life.
The soldier decided that he must protect this peaceful creature.
They spent the whole afternoon discussing poetry and beautiful songs.
They made a clever plan so the townspeople would feel safe.
There would be a play battle in the afternoon near the community.
Everyone from the village came out to watch the big event.
The soldier and the animal played their parts well without real danger.
If they finished the performance, the crowd would cheer.
The villagers stood near the bottom of the hill with open eyes.
They watched the two figures move across the open space.
Swords clashed in the air while both actors pretended to fight.
The animal made big dramatic movements to look very fierce.
The soldier shouted loudly and fell down upon the grass.
Everyone held their breath while watching the exciting scene unfold.
The performance looked completely real to all the worried watchers below.
They prepared themselves for the final moment of the show.
After the play fight ended, the crowd cheered for the soldier.
The animal was invited down into the village for a party.
He ate good food, shared his books, and danced with the local people.
From that day on, the animal lived happily among his new friends.
He has never felt sad again since that wonderful day.
Children ran up to him and asked him to read more stories.
The old man smiled while watching his friend enjoy the celebration.
Everyone realized that the large creature had a kind and gentle heart.
Music played through the night as the villagers danced together.
The animal knew he would always have a home in the town.
Peace returned to the mountain and the valley below forever.
He thanked his friends for giving him such a wonderful new life.
His heart was full of joy as he looked at the stars.

sentences.text: High up in the wild mountains, a gentle creature lived alone.

One fine morning, an old man from the local town came up the mountain.
The man found the animal resting near a big rock.
They started to talk, and the human was surprised to discover how kind the creature was.
The individual showed his newest poems to the visitor, and they became good friends.
Soon, the people in the town heard about the individual living on the hill.
They felt very afraid because they believed that all such animals were dangerous.
The local community asked a capable worker to come and drive the creature away.
However, the old man knew that the individual meant no harm and tried to help.
The person walked up the mountain to face the animal in battle.
Instead of fighting, the two met and talked about art, poetry, and life.

His heart was full of gratitude for the wonderful life he had found.
Years went by, but the strong friendship between the man and the creature never faded.
Visitors continued to climb the mountain to share stories and listen to poetry.
The whole region remained peaceful and happy forever.
The story of their unusual bond was told to every new generation in the town.
